notes.title: Patch 1 26.07.2023
notes.content:
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed a crash when attempting to load the Beach during the "Rescue Sparkles" quest
[*] Resolved an issue preventing the "Training" option from appearing on the phone for some players
[*] Fixed multiple crashes related to various dog interactions
[*] Fixed collision around buildings on the trail
[*] Fixed a soft lock when the dog gets distracted behind the player
[/list]

tags.bug: - Fixed a crash when attempting to load the Beach during the "Rescue Sparkles" quest
- Resolved an issue preventing the "Training" option from appearing on the phone for some players
- Fixed multiple crashes related to various dog interactions
- Fixed collision around buildings on the trail
- Fixed a soft lock when the dog gets distracted behind the player
